name: Blood for the Empire [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
When fighting alongside you, the sight of a bloodied foe inspires your allies to greatness, while a martyred comrade compels all of you to vengeance.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +4.

Benefit(s): You grant a +2 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls against any target that you damaged within the last round to all allies until the start of your next turn. When you or an ally dies within 30 feet of you, you or your allies gain the effects of haste for 1 round.
